test_title: PYST 216: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 7th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. V is second to the right of R. P is fourth to the left of S. T is third to the left of U. Only Q is between S and T. Who is sitting between P and T?
solution:
Eight friends **P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W** are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1. T is third to the left of U.

2. Only Q is between S and T.

 Case -I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8452d53c6958b05b3c0deb72eae5f380d37aec009e594f54d2a58f4dea8c247.png] 

 Case -II
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b7bcdf26f0dd87561d054e3fd84c659e3922aeb6e6b9b6678754cc6504456c6.png] 

3. P is fourth to the left of S.

Case -I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6524c44d9f8defef1778ac34dc2d1bd940d8c48c856dfddc30a57c0aec5a11f0.png] 

Case -II

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db18f1f230cb25b1f64ca733cee7b1afbb34145c4c7d2d84de1f904d0310d85a.png] 

4. V is second to the right of R. 

The above condition cannot be satisfied in Case II, so it is eliminated.

Case -I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04e0f33c3bf11cf2c0f745110e7dc4b71b9d78ce717a0bfe530b69fbdbaeeeae.png] 

As W is the only person left, it will occupy the vacant position.

Case -I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f44d1400a672a51b8fbb9c7fe51e87eea8c342e2beb310b805dd016d3d803bb3.png] 

Clearly, V is is sitting between P and T.

Hence, '**V**' is the correct answer.
